arabic_text: وَ بِفاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِساءِ الْعالَمينَ،
transliteration: wa bi fāţimata sayyidati nisā'il ālamīn,
english_text: By Fatima, the chief of women of the worlds,

arabic_text: وَ بِالْحَسَنِ الزَّكِيِّ عِصْمَةِ الْمُتَّقينَ،
english_text: By al-Hasan, the purified one and the protection of the pious,

arabic_text: وَ بِأبي عَبْدِاللهِ الْحُسَيْنِ أكْرَمِ الْمُسْتَشْهَدينَ،
english_text: By Abi Abdillah, al-Husain, the most honored martyr,

arabic_text: وَ بِأوْلادِهِ الْمَقْتُولينَ، وَ بِعِتْرَتِهِ الْمَظْلُومينَ،
transliteration: wa bi-'awlādihil maqtūlīn wa bi itratihil mađlūmīn,
english_text: By his slain children and oppressed family,

arabic_text: وَ بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ الْعابِدينَ،
transliteration: wa bi aliyyibnil ħusayni zaynil ābidīn,
english_text: By Ali Ibn al-Husain, the ornament of the worshippers,

arabic_text: وَ بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قِبْلَةِ الأوّابينَ،
english_text: By Muhammad Ibn Ali, the direction of those who turn to Allah,

arabic_text: وَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ أصْدَقِ الصّادِقينَ،
english_text: By Ja’far Ibn Muhammad, the most truthful,

arabic_text: وَ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ مُظْهِرِ الْبَراهينَ،
english_text: By Musa Ibn Ja’far, the discloser of the proofs,

arabic_text: وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسى ناصِرِ الدّينِ،
english_text: By Ali Ibn Musa, the helper of the religion,

arabic_text: وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قُدْوَةِ الْمُهْتَدينَ،
english_text: By Muhammad Ibn Ali, the exemplar of those who accepted guidance,

arabic_text: وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ أزْهَدِ الزّاهِدينَ،
english_text: By Ali Ibn Muhammad, the most ascetic,

arabic_text: وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ وارِثِ الْمُسْتَخْلَفينَ،
english_text: By Hasan Ibn Ali, the inheritor of the appointed ones,

arabic_text: وَالْحُجَّةِ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ أجْمَعينَ،
english_text: By the Proof upon all creation (al-Mahdi),

arabic_text: أنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
transliteration: 'an tušalliya alā muħammadin wa āli muħammad,
english_text: Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

arabic_text: الصّادِقينَ الأبَرّينَ، آلِ طه وَ يس،
english_text: the most truthful and devoted ones (who are) the family ofTaha and Yasin,[1]

arabic_text: وَ أنْ تَجْعَلَني فِي الْقِيامَةِ مِنَ الآمِنينَ الْمُطْمَئِنّينَ،
transliteration: wa 'an tajalani fil qiyāmati minal āminīnal muţma'innīn,
english_text: and place me on the Day of Judgment among those who are safe, confident,

arabic_text: الْفائِزينَ الْفَرِحينَ الْمُسْتَبْشِرينَ،
english_text: triumphant, happy, and felicitous.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ اكْتُبْني فِي الْمُسْلِمينَ،
english_text: O Allah! Destine me to be amongst the submitters,

arabic_text: وَ ألْحِقْني بِالصّالِحينَ،
english_text: Join me with the righteous,[1]

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لي لِسانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الآخِرينَ،
transliteration: wajal lī lisāna šidqin fil ākhirīn,
english_text: Ordain for me (offspring with) truthful tongue among the last generation,[2]

arabic_text: وَانْصُرْني عَلَى الْباغينَ،
english_text: Make me victorious over the transgressors,

arabic_text: وَاكْفِني كَيْدَ الْحاسِدينَ،
english_text: Suffice me the deception of the envious,

arabic_text: وَاصْرِفْ عَنّي مَكْرَ الْماكِرينَ،
english_text: Turn away from me the evil plans of the schemers,

arabic_text: وَاقْبِضْ عَنّي أيْدِيَ الظّالِمينَ،
english_text: Hold back from me the hands of the oppressors,

arabic_text: وَاجْمَعْ بَيْني وَ بَيْنَ السّادَةِ الْمَيامينِ في أعْلا عِلِّيّينَ،
transliteration: wajma baynī wa baynas-sādatil mayāmīni fī 'alā illiyyīn,
english_text: Gather me with the blessed masters in the utmost exalted place of Heaven,

arabic_text: مَعَ الَّذينَ أنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيّينَ وَ الصِّدّيقينَ وَ الشُّهَداءِ وَ الصّالِحينَ،
transliteration: maal-ladhīna 'anamta alayhim minal nabiyyīna waš-šiddīqīna wash-shuhadā'i waš-šāliħīn,
english_text: along with whom You have bestowed favor, from among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous,[]

arabic_text: بِرَحْمَتِكَ يا أرْحَمَ الرّاحِمينَ،
english_text: By Your mercy, O the most merciful of the merciful.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي اُقْسِمُ عَلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ الْمَعْصُومِ،
english_text: O Allah! I implore You by Your infallible Prophet,

arabic_text: وَ بِحُكْمِكَ الْمَحْتُومِ، وَ نُهْيَكَ [نَهْيِكَ] الْمَكْتُومِ،
transliteration: wa biħukmikal maħtūm, wa nuhyakal maktūm,
english_text: by Your definite judgment, and Your concealed preventive wisdom,

arabic_text: وَ بِهذَا الْقَبْرِ الْمَلْمُومِ، الْمُوَسَّدِ في كَنَفِهِ الإمامُ الْمَعْصُومُ، الْمَقْتُولُ الْمَظْلُومُ،
transliteration: wa bihādhal qabril malmūm, al-muwassadi fī kanafihil 'imāmul mašūm, al-maqtūlul mađlūm,
english_text: by this grave which is the place of congregation and in which lies the infallible Imam, the slaughtered, and the oppressed,
